name: Progress tracker
purpose: Shows users how far they are through a multi-step process by filling a segmented track and labelling the current step (e.g. 'Step 2 of 4').

props.name: currentStep
props.$note: 1…totalSteps; segments up to the current step use progress/complete, the rest progress/incomplete.

tokens.label: text/default (#333333) @ font-5/medium (step) + font-5/light
tokens.$finding: (2026-06-20) progress/complete + progress/incomplete were BOTH flat #FFFFFF in dark (segments indistinguishable; the dark-surface gate misses non-surface fills). Reconciled: complete=#DB0011 (brand red), incomplete=#404040. Distinguished by hue.

accessibility.status: Expose as a progress indicator with an accessible name and current/total (role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax, or descriptive text 'Step 2 of 4')
accessibility.useOfColour: The red/grey fill must not be the only cue — pair with the step text label (1.4.1)
accessibility.announce: REVIEW (inferred): step changes should be announced (aria-live) as the user advances

antiPatterns: Showing progress by the bar fill alone without a 'Step X of Y' label
REVIEW (inferred): using a progress tracker for an unknown number of steps (use an indeterminate loading indicator instead)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — CLEAN, no deprecated tokens. Uses the dedicated progress/* pair + text/default.

depricateUsage.note: None. progress/complete (#db0011) + progress/incomplete (#ededed) are live semantic tokens.

build.$status: PROMOTED 2026-06-22 (Dave) — gated reference: snippets/Progress-tracker.reference.html. Build green; prototype-grade 9.0/9.
build.$visualCorrection: Canon previously rendered a dots-and-connectors stepper (numbered circles + connector lines + per-step labels) — that diverged from this meta and the Figma. Corrected to the SEGMENTED TRACK the source defines (node 267:10760): a 'Step X of Y' label + optional title + flat filled segments (progress/complete up to the current step, progress/incomplete after).
build.interactiveDecision: PASSIVE (interactive:false) status display, like Table + Status-indicator — NOT a navigation control. AT earned the passive way: role=progressbar + aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax + aria-valuetext + an aria-live 'Step X of Y' announcement + accessible name. A real Back/Next control drives it and carries the interactive hover/active/focus/disabled states honestly (same pattern Status-indicator used). No clickable-step navigation bolted on.
build.prototypeGrade: 9.0/9 (2026-06-22). Square segments (brand angular); flexible-width track + @container nav reflow; colour never the only cue (the 'Step X of Y' label carries meaning, 1.4.1).
